title: Coverage-Type Changes Already Settled and the TRICARE Reserve Select Early-Duty Month Credit
content:
**TRICARE Premium-Based Plans - TRICARE Reserve Select ledger rule.**

A coverage-type change already settled for the most recently paid month changes what the early-duty month credit returns: where a coverage-type change credit stands against that month's bill, that credit is taken off; where a coverage-type adjustment bill for that month has a payment posted against it, that adjustment is added; otherwise nothing is taken off or added.

1. *Change credit.* The credits with reason coverage-type change posted against the monthly bill of the most recently paid month, in total.
2. *Paid adjustment.* The coverage-type adjustment billed for that coverage month, in its full billed amount, where the adjustment bill has a payment posted against it.
3. The cases are read in that order: where a change credit stands against the bill, it is the change credit that is taken off.

## Cases (hypothetical)

| Most recently paid month's ledger | Change to what the credit returns |
|---|---|
| a coverage-type change credit of 88.24 stands against the monthly bill | 88.24 taken off |
| a coverage-type adjustment bill of 240.65 for that month, with a payment posted against it | 240.65 added |
| a coverage-type adjustment bill for that month with no payment posted against it | nothing |
| no change credit and no adjustment bill | nothing |
